# Host Grotesk

The variable Host Grotesk font (weights 300 to 800, roman and italic) for sfgl
apps. Each style is split into a Latin file and a Latin Extended file; the
browser loads only the ones a page's text needs.

Source: `@fontsource-variable/host-grotesk` 5.3.0 (the `woff2` files, unmodified),
from the upstream project https://github.com/Element-Type/HostGrotesk.

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the full text and copyright
notice are in `OFL.txt`. The font may be bundled and redistributed with sfgl
and with apps that use it, but not sold by itself.
